title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of member States to ratify and apply international labour standards and to fulfil their reporting obligations

description.narrative: In March 2023, the Government of Lesotho ratified ILO Conventions C.151; C. 187 and C.190 and enacted the Labour Act as well as OSH Act in April 2024. ILO support will include sensitisation and awareness on the application of the recently ratified Conventions incuding C.151 on promoting Collective Bargaining in the Public Service as welll the amendment of the Public Service Act to esnure compliance with Implementation of the Labour Relations (Public Service) Convention, 1978 (No. 151). During the biennium, the ILO will provide support on raising awareness amongst the social partners and key government ministries on the ratification new/selected Conventions, improved application and reporting on ratified Conventions. Technical will also be provided on the amendment of the public service act in line with C.151, in collaboration with the Ministry of Public Service.
